notes: All 26 points were offline ground-plane spatial uncertainty evaluation samples from DS_V3_3_OOS_INDEPENDENT_EVAL.
No physical vehicle actuators or autonomous drive controls were coupled during offline uncertainty evaluation.

Being outside the statistical k_H confidence ellipse means measurement error exceeded the 95% boundary (Mahalanobis distance > k_H), which represents a statistical uncertainty calibration failure, not an established physical collision hazard.
Downstream safety filters (temporal hazard debounce, TTC time-to-collision threshold, multi-frame tracking persistence) were not simulated closed-loop for these static points.

In accordance with Section 4 and Section 6 governance rules, these 26 points are strictly classified as UNCERTAINTY_COVERAGE_FAILURE_WITHIN_AUTONOMOUS_POLICY_REGION and must never be reported as UNSAFE_ACTION or UNSAFE_NON_REFUSAL without physical actuator evidence.
